environment.description: ECS Fargate service in an isolated private subnet (no NAT gateway, no IGW route). Step Functions access is exclusively through a com.amazonaws.us-east-1.states VPC Interface Endpoint with a restrictive endpoint policy allowing only states:StartExecution on the specific state machine ARN. The VPC endpoint has a security group that only permits inbound TCP/443 from the ECS task security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Route tables for the subnet have NO 0.0.0.0/0 route entry. The service is fronted by an internal NLB accessible only from within the VPC via a secondary VPC endpoint (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0abc123def456). DNS resolution for the service is handled by Route 53 Private Hosted Zone bound to the VPC. There is no path from the public internet to this service - the only consumers are other internal microservices within the same VPC that have been granted access to the VPC endpoint service via allowed principals list.

config.route_table: local VPC CIDR only, no 0.0.0.0/0 route
config.service_exposure: internal NLB via VPC endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0abc123def456)
